title: Classified DoD payloads as evidence of a secret space program

tellings.quote:
we know
that at Vandenberg Air Force bases there
are classified payloads that are
launched into space routinely.

plain: Secret cargo for the US military is routinely launched into space from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, and some see that as a sign of a hidden space program. An unnamed researcher who appeared as a guest says this without naming a source, speaking of launches from roughly the 1980s and 1990s. If true, it would mean some of what goes into orbit is never shown to the public.
